data.name: Busy Bar - World Tour
data.detailed_description:
Serve drinks, survive ridiculous guests, upgrade your bars, and buy out rival moguls — solo or in co-op — in a chill bar empire game where every shift ends in progress.

Survive Ridiculous Guests

Your customers are more than walking orders.

Some leave generous tips. Some steal your coins. Some fall asleep on the counter and block your lane. Some jump onto the bar and dance until every incoming drink shatters. Others may drop suspicious gifts, change their order mid-shift, or even kidnap the bartender and throw them out the door.

Learn each guest’s behavior, react to their abilities, and turn unpredictable bar chaos into profit.

Hire Barbacks from Your Guests

Some guests are more than customers — they might become your next barback. Spot promising regulars during a shift and hire them for a one-time fee to help out at that specific bar.

Barbacks come with different accuracy, speed and skill stats, plus specialties like cleaning spills, collecting glasses, gathering tips or helping with orders. Some are common helpers, others are rare finds that can completely change how a busy shift feels. It is completely optional, but adds an extra layer of strategy for players who want it. Play solo, bring friends or mix local players and barbacks in any setup that fits your bar.

Build your Bars, One Chaotic Shift at a Time.

Busy Bar is a chill arcade-management game about serving drinks, handling ridiculous guests, upgrading unique bars and buying out rival moguls across the world.

Every shift ends in progress. There are no harsh fail states or game-over days — you always earn something, improve something, and move one step closer to owning the next bar. The challenge is not whether you survive the day, but how well you handle the chaos.

Build a Global Bar Empire

Start small, then expand across the world. Travel between cities on the world map, discover new bars, and decide where to work next.

Each bar has its own layout, style, guest mix, upgrade path, and owner. Some are cheap starter pubs, others are expensive premium venues controlled by powerful rivals. Earn money, buy them out, and grow your empire one property at a time.

Upgrade and Personalize your Bars

Spend your earnings between shifts to improve each bar. Unlock new equipment, activate extra counters, change walls and floors, place decorations, and watch your venue visibly transform as it levels up. Each levels increase your profit in shifts.

Your upgrades are not just numbers in a menu — bought items appear directly inside the bar. A rough little pub can slowly become a stylish, profitable venue that feels like your own.

Defeat Rival Bar Moguls

You are not the only one building an empire.

The Mogul Rankings track rival bar tycoons, their wealth, their bars, and their position on the leaderboard. As you buy their properties and increase your own wealth, you climb the rankings and push them down.

Take a mogul’s last bar, and they disappear from the leaderboard completely. One less rival. One step closer to the top.

Play Solo or in Local Co-op

Run the bar alone or bring a friend in local 4-player co-op on one shared screen. Choose different bartenders, split the work, rescue each other from trouble, or accidentally make everything worse.

Co-op adds coordination, chaos, and plenty of funny moments — especially when guests start blocking lanes, breaking drinks, or dragging bartenders across the room.

Run Chaotic Bar Shifts

Step behind the counter, charge your throw, and slide drinks down the lane to waiting customers. Recall empty glasses, collect tips, clean up spills, and keep the bar moving as orders pile up.

The controls are simple to learn, but each shift becomes a satisfying mix of timing, positioning, and optimization. Pick a short, normal, or long shift, then try to earn as much as you can before the day ends.

Fully Playable with Keyboard and Mouse or a Controller

A controller is recommended for the smoothest experience, but all gameplay features are fully playable with keyboard and mouse as well.

Key Features

  • Chill, shift-based arcade-management gameplay

  • No harsh fail states — every shift ends in progress

  • Drink throwing, glass recalling, tip collecting, and cleanup

  • 25 different type of ridiculous guests with 15+ different abilities including sleepers, dancers, thieves, bombs, reorders, and kidnappers

  • Local 1-4 player co-op on one shared screen

  • Unique bars with different layouts, styles, guests, and upgrades

  • Visible bar progression with new counters, items, walls, floors, and decorations

  • World map travel between cities and bars

  • Rival Mogul leaderboard with buyouts and empire progression

  • Multiple bartenders with different looks and animations

Busy Bar is a cozy-chaotic bar game about relaxed optimization, funny accidents, and the satisfaction of turning one small pub into a worldwide bar empire.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200 (or equivalent quad-core @ 3.0 GHz)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 950 / AMD Radeon RX 460 / Intel UHD 630 (2 GB VRAM, DirectX 11)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Local co-op requires two controllers
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600 (6-core)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580 (4 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Local co-op requires two controllers
